text.en: What patterns should I notice in how I approach new romantic connections?
text.zh: 面對新的感情可能時，我可以留意自己哪些互動習慣？

text.en: What should I notice about pacing and reciprocity in this dating connection?
text.zh: 在約會或曖昧互動中，我可以怎麼觀察彼此的步調與付出是否對等？

text.en: How can I compare discussing a recurring disagreement now with scheduling a calmer conversation?
text.zh: 面對反覆出現的分歧，我該如何比較現在談清楚與另約平靜時間再談？

text.en: If neither of us has requested no contact, how can I compare one respectful check-in with keeping some distance?
text.zh: 若雙方沒有約定不聯絡，我該如何比較一次尊重界線的問候與繼續保持距離？

text.en: What is one low-pressure way I can make room to meet someone new?
text.zh: 我可以先做哪件低壓的小事，為認識新對象留出空間？

text.en: How can I raise an unmet need without deciding what my partner intended?
text.zh: 我可以怎麼表達尚未被滿足的需要，而不先替伴侶的動機下結論？

text.en: What should I examine when my workload feels difficult to organize?
text.zh: 當工作量變得難以安排時，我應先檢查哪些環節？

text.en: What should I notice about how I ask for and use feedback at work?
text.zh: 對於工作上的回饋，我可以留意自己如何詢問與採用？

text.en: How can I compare deepening my current role with exploring a different role?
text.zh: 我該如何比較深化目前職務與探索不同職務？

text.en: How can I compare completing this task alone with asking for collaboration?
text.zh: 面對這項任務，我該如何比較獨立完成與尋求合作？

text.en: What can I clarify first when a project brief is too vague to act on?
text.zh: 當工作需求太模糊而無法開始時，我可以先釐清什麼？

text.en: How can I make my contributions visible without overstating them?
text.zh: 我可以怎麼讓自己的工作貢獻被看見，又不誇大成果？

text.en: What should I review when my spending no longer matches my priorities?
text.zh: 當支出和自己的優先事項越來越不一致時，我可以先檢視什麼？

text.en: What should I verify when reviewing my goal of earning NT$30,000 this week?
text.zh: 檢視這週賺三萬元台幣的目標時，我需要先核實哪些條件？

text.en: How can I compare buying a nonessential item now with waiting a month?
text.zh: 對一項非必要購物，我該如何比較現在買與等一個月再決定？

text.en: How can I compare taking extra paid hours with reducing an optional expense?
text.zh: 我該如何比較增加有酬工時與減少一項非必要開銷？

text.en: What is a manageable first step toward understanding where my money goes?
text.zh: 想看清錢花到哪裡，我可以從哪個做得到的小步驟開始？

text.en: What should I clarify before counting an expected payment as available money?
text.zh: 把一筆預期款項當成可用資金前，我應先確認什麼？

text.en: What should I examine when I study for hours but retain very little?
text.zh: 讀了很久卻記不住時，我可以先檢查自己的學習方式哪些部分？

text.en: What is making my current learning goal hard to keep in focus?
text.zh: 哪些安排可能讓我難以持續聚焦目前的學習目標？

text.en: How can I compare a structured course with a self-directed study plan?
text.zh: 我該如何比較有進度安排的課程與自主學習計畫？

text.en: How can I compare reviewing the basics with starting an advanced topic?
text.zh: 我該如何比較回頭補基礎與開始更進階的主題？

text.en: What can I do first when an assignment feels too large to begin?
text.zh: 當作業大到讓我不知如何開始時，我可以先做哪一步？

text.en: How can I ask for help with material I do not understand?
text.zh: 遇到不懂的學習內容時，我可以怎麼求助才更具體？

text.en: What should I notice when a friendship feels less balanced to me?
text.zh: 當我覺得一段友誼不太對等時，可以先觀察哪些互動？

text.en: What should I examine about my place in a group conversation?
text.zh: 在團體聊天中，我可以怎麼理解自己的參與方式？

text.en: How can I compare accepting this social invitation with declining and suggesting another time?
text.zh: 我該如何比較接受這次邀約與婉拒後另約時間？

text.en: How can I compare addressing a misunderstanding privately with requesting a group discussion?
text.zh: 面對誤會，我該如何比較私下澄清與請大家一起討論？

text.en: How can I reconnect with a friend without pressuring them to respond?
text.zh: 我可以怎麼重新聯絡朋友，又不讓對方有必須回覆的壓力？

text.en: How can I set a limit when a social request exceeds what I can offer?
text.zh: 當別人的請求超過我能負擔的範圍時，我可以怎麼表達界線？

text.en: What should I notice when my daily choices drift away from what matters to me?
text.zh: 當日常選擇逐漸偏離自己重視的事，我可以先留意什麼？

text.en: What pattern should I examine when I keep postponing a personal project?
text.zh: 當我一直延後一個個人計畫時，可以檢視哪些反覆出現的模式？

text.en: How can I compare keeping a familiar routine with trying a small change?
text.zh: 我該如何比較維持熟悉的日常與嘗試一個小改變？

text.en: How can I compare taking on a new personal goal with finishing an existing one?
text.zh: 我該如何比較開始新的個人目標與先完成原有目標？

text.en: What small action could make tomorrow more consistent with my priorities?
text.zh: 我可以做哪件小事，讓明天更接近自己重視的生活？

text.en: How can I review a recent setback without turning it into a judgment of my worth?
text.zh: 我可以怎麼回顧一次挫折，而不把它當成對自己價值的判決？
